data.one_liner: Flutter SVGA animation player with intelligent caching, audio support, and dynamic elements.
data.what_it_does: Parses and renders SVGA vector animations in Flutter. It includes automatic disk caching, built-in audio playback with volume controls, and support for dynamic text, image replacement, and custom canvas drawing layers.
use_when: You need to render SVGA animation files from assets or remote URLs
Your animations require synchronized audio playback with volume control
You want to dynamically modify text or swap images inside running vector animations
avoid_when: You prefer standard Lottie JSON animations and already use the lottie package
You do not need SVGA format or vector animations
strengths: Active replacement for the archived svgaplayer_flutter package
Built-in automatic disk caching with cache expiration and size limits
Integrated audio playback with volume and mute architecture
Memory optimized with automatic protobuf heap release
weaknesses: Limited to the SVGA animation format ecosystem
Requires managing animation controllers for advanced playback control

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Lottie if you prefer using JSON-based Lottie vector animations instead of the SVGA format.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Rive if you need interactive, state-driven vector animations and game-like motion graphics.
